description: Update an existing task — any subset of fields. Pass notification_minutes_before to reschedule the reminder (or null to clear it).

category_id.description: Category ID. Must be owned by or shared to this user.

completed_at.description: Mark as completed (ISO format) or null to uncomplete

due_time.description: Time of day in HH:MM (24h). Optional when due_date already carries a time.

is_all_day.description: Mark as all-day event — suppresses time-of-day rendering.

location.description: Human-readable location (e.g., "Starbucks Gangnam"). For GPS use location_lat/lng.

notes.description: Free-form notes / details attached to the task.

notification_minutes_before.description: Schedule a reminder N minutes before due_date. Pass null/omit to clear existing MCP reminder on update. Requires due_date.

repeat_rule.description: Recurrence rule. Accepted values depend on server (e.g., "daily", "weekly", "monthly", or RRULE). Creates a recurring series.

start_date.description: Start date for multi-day events (ISO format). For single-day tasks, use due_date.

travel_time.description: Minutes of travel time before due_date to allow for. Used by reminder scheduling.

name: update_task
